title: `colgroup` elements should map `width` attribute to the dimension property `width`
body:
### What is the issue with the HTML Standard? From https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/rendering.html#tables-2 > The [table](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/tables.html#the-table-element) element's [height](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/obsolete.html#attr-table-height) attribute [maps to the dimension property](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/rendering.html#maps-to-the-dimension-property) ['height'](https://drafts.csswg.org/css2/#the-height-property) on the [table](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/tables.html#the-table-element) element. > > The [table](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/tables.html#the-table-element) element's [width](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/obsolete.html#attr-table-width) attribute [maps to the dimension property (ignoring zero)](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/rendering.html#maps-to-the-dimension-property-(ignoring-zero)) ['width'](https://drafts.csswg.org/css2/#the-width-property) on the [table](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/tables.html#the-table-element) element. > > The [col](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/tables.html#the-col-element) element's [width](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/obsolete.html#attr-col-width) attribute [maps to the dimension property](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/rendering.html#maps-to-the-dimension-property) ['width'](https://drafts.csswg.org/css2/#the-width-property) on the [col](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/tables.html#the-col-element) element. > > The [thead](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/tables.html#the-thead-element), [tbody](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/tables.html#the-tbody-element), and [tfoot](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/tables.html#the-tfoot-element) elements' [height](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/obsolete.html#attr-tbody-height) attribute [maps to the dimension property](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/rendering.html#maps-to-the-dimension-property) ['height'](https://drafts.csswg.org/css2/#the-height-property) on the element. > > The [tr](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/tables.html#the-tr-element) element's [height](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/obsolete.html#attr-tr-height) attribute [maps to the dimension property](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/rendering.html#maps-to-the-dimension-property) ['height'](https://drafts.csswg.org/css2/#the-height-property) on the [tr](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/tables.html#the-tr-element) element. > > The [td](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/tables.html#the-td-element) and [th](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/tables.html#the-th-element) elements' [height](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/obsolete.html#attr-tdth-height) attributes [map to the dimension property (ignoring zero)](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/rendering.html#maps-to-the-dimension-property-(ignoring-zero)) ['height'](https://drafts.csswg.org/css2/#the-height-property) on the element. > > The [td](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/tables.html#the-td-element) and [th](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/tables.html#the-th-element) elements' [width](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/obsolete.html#attr-tdth-width) attributes [map to the dimension property (ignoring zero)](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/rendering.html#maps-to-the-dimension-property-(ignoring-zero)) ['width'](https://drafts.csswg.org/css2/#the-width-property) on the element. This is missing `colgroup` elements, that share the `HTMLTableColElement` interface with `col` elements. Testcase: ```html
``` That's a 100x100 table on Gecko, Blink and WebKit.
